description: Top-down arcade racing built for the R1 controls: scroll wheel steers like an RC car, side button is the gas, touch D/R gear + E-brake buttons. Drift physics, 8 progressively harder tracks with hazards, cups, daily challenges, Time Trial ghosts/medals, 20 cars + 33 style unlocks from pity-timer chests.
title: R1 Drift Racer
